one_shot_draws.pairing_rule: Every frozen model family is evaluated at every listed seed. The same seed is used across families so shared generator components remain paired where their structural definitions coincide.

replication_sensitivity.role: predeclared lower-replication-threshold sensitivity; never substituted for the primary score

class_weighting.within_class_rule: arithmetic mean of row losses within the requested scope
class_weighting.reason: Prevent the 24 block-R2 or 20 incremental rows from dominating the six structure rows merely by row count.

structure.note: The 0.05 model-discrepancy floor prevents bootstrap sampling precision from being treated as exact mechanistic tolerance.

environment_block_r2.loss: squared transformed difference divided by 0.10 squared
environment_block_r2.note: Square-root R2 places small and moderate explained fractions on an effect-amplitude scale without target-specific tuning.

environment_geometry.note: Cosine is already bounded on [-1,1]; 0.25 is the frozen operational geometry discrepancy scale.

environment_incremental.loss: squared transformed difference divided by 0.10 squared
environment_incremental.note: Only the preregistered partial-R2 scalar enters model distance. Observed permutation P/Q/support states remain descriptive evidence and are not double-counted.

family_summary.primary_statistic: median total class-balanced distance across the 16 paired draws
family_summary.primary_tie_rule: A family is tied with the primary median leader when its primary median is no more than max(5 percent of the leader median, 0.01) above the leader median.
family_summary.paired_win_fraction: For each ordered family pair, fraction of the 16 matched seeds on which the first family has lower total distance; exact ties count 0.5.

requirements: exactly one family is outside the primary tie ambiguity set as the lowest primary median
its primary paired-win fraction is at least 0.75 against every other family
its replication-sensitivity median rank is at most 2
its replication-sensitivity median is within 10 percent of the best replication-sensitivity median
robust_leader_rule.failure_interpretation: The frozen target bundle does not identify one structural family strongly enough under the preregistered comparison; do not retune priors, weights, transforms or family membership to rescue a winner.

factor_contrasts.residual_architecture: paired score(COUPLED) - score(MODULAR) within otherwise matched families; positive values favour MODULAR
factor_contrasts.scale_coefficient_architecture: paired score(SHARED) - score(INDEPENDENT) within otherwise matched non-null families; positive values favour INDEPENDENT
factor_contrasts.process_both_vs_core4: paired score(CORE4) - score(PROCESS_BOTH) within matched scale/residual architecture; positive values favour PROCESS_BOTH
factor_contrasts.process_among_only_vs_core4: paired score(CORE4) - score(PROCESS_AMONG_ONLY) within matched scale/residual architecture; positive values favour PROCESS_AMONG_ONLY
factor_contrasts.process_among_only_vs_process_both: paired score(PROCESS_BOTH) - score(PROCESS_AMONG_ONLY) within matched scale/residual architecture; positive values favour PROCESS_AMONG_ONLY
factor_contrasts.direction_consistency_rule: report the median contrast and fraction of paired contrasts with the preregistered positive direction; >=0.75 is labelled direction-consistent, not causal support

held_out_evidence_rule: FDT1 pollinator, antagonist, orientation, phyllary and stickiness evidence is not part of this 62-target fit. It remains independent interpretation/validation evidence and cannot be used to change the one-shot ranking after inspection.
prohibited_post_outcome_actions: change any target-class weight or row-loss scale
drop a target, scope, model family or draw because of its effect on ranking
change generator priors, endpoint loadings, residual architecture or process permissions
replace min5 with min2 as the primary analysis
add observed P/Q/support states as extra score terms after seeing results
declare a causal or adaptive mechanism from the structural ranking
claim_boundary: This one-shot comparison can discriminate structural sufficiency among the 14 frozen generator families for the 62 Azami observational estimands. It is not a likelihood analysis, posterior inference, causal identification, proof of adaptation, plasticity, defence, or genetic/developmental modularity.
